DHAKA, June 29 (Reuter) - The Bangladesh taka closed steady at 43.7400/7480 to the dollar in interbank trading on adequate supply of the greenbank, dealers said. The taka quoted at 43.7400/7500 in early trading against the previous close at 43.7400/7450. The local unit was mostly steady mainly because of an adequate supply of dollar in the market, the dealers said. Dealers said the interbank call money rates closed lower at 5.5 percent to 6.5 percent against the previous 6.5-10.0 percent as the market liquidity had improved. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363 REUTER
